dog.description_text:
Darlene’s foster describes her in four simple words: “the absolute sweetest.”

Darlene is a quiet soul who’s at her happiest outdoors. She really comes alive at the park, and she’s a dream on leash, walking nicely without pulling. She’s been enjoying walks alongside her foster’s resident dog, too, and the two have been sniffing and strolling side by side. At home, she’s crate-trained and has her own cozy spot where she feels safe. She’s also a great eater who never leaves a bite behind!

Registered adopters interested in Darlene can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you’re not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
